title: Jewel Tone & Gold Foil
prompt: Fill the background with a rich matte jewel tone (deep emerald or sapphire) carrying a faint tone-on-tone damask pattern. Render all linework and lettering in antique brushed-gold foil on textured ivory cotton paper.

title: Gold Foil on Navy
prompt: Polished gold foil on deep navy cardstock. Crisp foil edges with a subtle highlight where the light catches; no other colours.

title: Forest Green & Cream
prompt: Two-colour palette: deep forest green ink on warm cream. Flat inks, no gradients, no texture.

title: Terracotta & Blush
prompt: Warm terracotta and soft blush on a cream ground. Matte, flat and earthy, like a screen print on uncoated paper.

title: Monochrome Minimal
prompt: Single colour: solid black on pure white. Refined flat vector with crisp edges and generous negative space; remove all texture and shading.

title: Neutral with One Accent
prompt: Keep a neutral charcoal and off-white palette and add one high-energy accent colour (optic yellow-green) on a single secondary element only.

title: Letterpress on Cotton
prompt: Deep letterpress impression into thick cotton paper: ink slightly pooled at the edges of the bite, visible paper fibres, soft natural window light from the side.

title: Blind Emboss
prompt: Raised blind emboss with no ink on heavy textured ivory stock, lit by low raking side light so the design reads only through highlights and shadows.

title: Wax Seal
prompt: Pressed into a deep oxblood wax seal: glossy wax, irregular poured edges, fine detail in the impression. Top-down macro product shot on linen.

title: Carved Marble
prompt: Carved in shallow relief into ivory marble with soft grey veining; gentle museum lighting picks out the edges of the carving.

title: Embroidered Patch
prompt: An embroidered patch: dense satin-stitch thread texture, slight thread sheen, merrowed border, photographed flat on denim.

title: Stained Glass
prompt: Leaded stained glass: jewel-coloured glass panes separated by dark lead came, warm daylight shining through.

title: Neon Sign
prompt: Glowing neon tubing mounted on a dark brick wall at night, soft colour bloom around each tube, visible mounting clips.

title: Polished Chrome
prompt: Polished chrome 3D render with mirror reflections and bevelled edges, Y2K style, on a soft gradient studio backdrop.

title: Watercolour Wash
prompt: Soft watercolour washes fill the shapes with pigment blooming past the edges, while the linework and lettering stay crisp and legible. Cold-press paper texture.

title: Hand-Drawn Ink Sketch
prompt: Hand-drawn fine-liner ink sketch: hatching for shading, slightly irregular line weight, a few construction lines left in, on off-white sketchbook paper.

title: Botanical Engraving
prompt: Fine-art copperplate engraving style, with delicate botanical line art (leaves and small flowers) woven into the negative space. Single dark ink on ivory.

title: Linocut Print
prompt: Bold linocut print: carved gouge texture, one ink colour, slight misregistration and uneven ink coverage.

title: Risograph
prompt: Two-colour risograph print in fluorescent pink and teal, visible grain, slight misregistration between layers.

title: Modern Flat Vector
prompt: Modern flat vector: simplified geometry, consistent stroke weights, a restrained three-colour palette, crisp and app-icon ready.

title: Soft Clay 3D
prompt: Soft 3D clay render: rounded, slightly puffy forms, pastel colours, gentle studio lighting with soft shadows.

title: Folk-Art Pastel
prompt: Hand-painted folk-art style in a pastel palette, with an intricate ornamental border of small flowers and leaves around the design.

title: Vintage Club Badge
prompt: Vintage club badge: cream and burgundy, slightly distressed print texture, heritage typography treatment that keeps the existing letterforms.

title: Art Deco Revival
prompt: Art Deco revival in black and gold: geometric sunburst rays and a stepped frame around the design, strict symmetry, 1920s poster finish.

title: Seamless Pattern
prompt: A seamless repeating wallpaper pattern made of the design at small scale in a staggered grid, tone-on-tone on a soft neutral ground.

title: Leather Luggage Tag
prompt: The design debossed into a tan leather luggage tag with brass hardware, photographed as a product shot on a wooden table.

title: Passport Stamp
prompt: The design as a rubber-stamp impression on a textured passport page: imperfect ink coverage, slight rotation, faint guilloche background.

title: Business Card
prompt: The design printed on a premium thick business card, shown at an angle on a stone surface with soft shadows.

title: T-Shirt Print
prompt: The design screen-printed on the chest of a heather-grey t-shirt, flat-lay photo, natural fabric texture showing through the ink.

title: Hanging Shop Sign
prompt: The design hand-painted on a wooden hanging shop sign on a wrought-iron bracket, photographed on a sunny street.
